versions.subject: Add rule for renamed vmnat.exe
versions.detection:
selection:
    OriginalFileName: 'vmnat.exe'
filter:
    Image|endswith: 'vmnat.exe'
condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: Update proc_creation_win_renamed_vmnat.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    OriginalFileName: 'vmnat.exe'
filter_rename:
    Image|endswith: 'vmnat.exe'
filter_portable:
    Image:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\VMware\VMware Workstation\vmnat.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\vmnat.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: OriginalFileName="vmnat.exe" NOT (Image="*vmnat.exe" OR Image IN ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\VMware\\VMware Workstation\\vmnat.exe", "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\vmnat.exe"))
